records.Name: GENERAL - Spelling & Grammar
records.dmd_ai__Content__c: Ensure that in document there are any errors in spelling and grammar.

records.Name: GENERAL - Clarity & Conciseness
records.dmd_ai__Content__c: Ensure that information is written in a clear and concise manner for better understanding.

records.Name: GENERAL - Audience-Appropriate Tone
records.dmd_ai__Content__c: Check if document follows a consistent tone and language that resonates with the target audience.

records.Name: GENERAL - Proper Formatting
records.dmd_ai__Content__c: Check if the document format properly and maintain a coherent structure throughout.

records.Name: GENERAL - Company Branding Compliance
records.dmd_ai__Content__c: Ensure that the document complies with company branding and style guidelines.
records.dmd_ai__Description__c: Compliant with company branding and style

records.Name: GENERAL - Simplified Language
records.dmd_ai__Content__c: Ensure that document is not using jargon, acronyms or technical terms without proper definitions or explanations.
records.dmd_ai__Description__c: No jargon or unexplained technical terms

records.Name: GENERAL - Purpose & Clarity
records.dmd_ai__Content__c: Review the document for clarity and verify it serves its intended purpose.
records.dmd_ai__Description__c: Meeting the intended purpose and clear content

records.Name: GENERAL - Contradictory Information
records.dmd_ai__Content__c: Ensure that document does not contains any contradictions within.
